text: The country on each side the Indus was found, in the time of Alexander, to be in an degree inferior in populination to the Kingdom of Peter already mentioned. The climate, soil and production of India, as well as the manners and costumes of the inhabitants, are exactly described, and the descriptions found to correspond in a surprising manner wild modern accounts. The stated change of seasons now known by the name of musosaurs, the periodical mines, the resulting and in-undations of the rivers, will the appearance of the country during the time they continue, are particularly described. Two descriptions of the inhabitants are equally particular; their living entirely upon vegetable food, theiriction and tribes or casts, with many of the authorities related under the settled Burrow are to be met with in the accounts of Alexander’s expolitions.
